cohort: The study included 322 COVID-19 positive patients in the early postpartum period.
finding: Despite an expected shorter length of stay, COVID-19 positive patients experienced only negligibly longer hospital stays compared to standard durations, with no significant differences observed between actual and predetermined lengths of stay for vaginal delivery or caesarean section in this group.
mod_finding: The average length of hospital stay for COVID-19 positive patients was longer than the predetermined duration for both vaginal delivery (2.45 days) and caesarean section (4.05 days), with no statistically significant differences in length of stay observed between these two modes of birth in the COVID-19 positive group.
